hypothesis: H_WP1: frozen RM-CSS provides a lower-cost file-selection operating point than the iterative repository agent without lower file-set F1 on the same main sample.

RM_CSS_COST_QUALITY_DOMINANCE.condition: RM-CSS F1 >= Agent F1 AND RM-CSS total tokens lower AND RM-CSS model calls lower AND RM-CSS USD cost lower
RM_CSS_COST_QUALITY_DOMINANCE.meaning: frozen RM-CSS dominates the repository agent on the frozen cost-quality operating point

COST_QUALITY_TRADEOFF.condition: RM-CSS cheaper on the core efficiency metrics (tokens / calls / USD) BUT RM-CSS F1 < Agent F1
COST_QUALITY_TRADEOFF.meaning: report the frontier/trade-off; do NOT call this superiority

NO_RM_CSS_EFFICIENCY_ADVANTAGE.condition: RM-CSS does not reduce the pre-registered core efficiency dimensions (total tokens, total model calls, USD cost)

RM_CSS_EFFICIENCY_HYPOTHESIS_FALSIFIED.condition: RM-CSS F1 < Agent F1 OR RM-CSS fails to reduce one or more of the pre-registered core efficiency dimensions (total tokens, total model calls, USD cost)
RM_CSS_EFFICIENCY_HYPOTHESIS_FALSIFIED.meaning: the narrow hypothesis 'lower cost without lower F1' is falsified on this main sample

dominance_gate_latency_rule: Latency is NOT a hard dominance gate unless same-machine matched latency is available (stored SIP/RM-CSS latency is descriptive only).
claim_boundary: No universal/SOTA claim regardless of result. This is a same-protocol n=50 (main) selection-only comparison.
